title: Home & HDB
description: Void decks, corridors, wet markets and the weather — heartland life.

example.zh: 我 家 在 宏茂桥。
example.en: My home is in Ang Mo Kio.

items.note: Public housing built by the HDB — most Singaporeans live in one.

example.zh: 我们 住 在 组屋。
example.en: We live in an HDB flat.

items.note: In Singapore 公寓 usually means a private condominium.

example.zh: 他 搬 去 公寓 了。
example.en: He moved into a condo.

example.zh: 我 在 楼下 等 你。
example.en: I'll wait for you downstairs.

example.zh: 楼上 的 邻居 很 吵。
example.en: The upstairs neighbours are noisy.

items.note: Singaporeans also say 楼顶 (lóu dǐng) for upstairs.

example.zh: 电梯 坏 了， 要 走 楼梯。
example.en: The lift is broken — we have to take the stairs.

items.note: The HDB common corridor — where neighbours chat and shoes pile up. Singaporean Mandarin also says 廊道 (láng dào).

example.zh: 不 要 把 鞋子 放 在 走廊。
example.en: Don't leave your shoes in the corridor.

example.zh: 我们 的 邻居 很 友善。
example.en: Our neighbours are very friendly.

items.note: From Malay "pasar". Besides food, you'll find clothes and household goods.

example.zh: 妈妈 去 巴刹 买 菜。
example.en: Mum went to the market to buy groceries.

items.note: "Wet" because the floors are always being hosed down. Usually in HDB estates.

example.zh: 湿巴刹 的 鱼 很 新鲜。
example.en: The fish at the wet market is very fresh.

items.note: Where you go for classes, events and to vote.

example.zh: 民众俱乐部 有 华文 课。
example.en: The community club has Chinese classes.

example.zh: 停车场 已经 满 了。
example.en: The carpark is already full.

example.zh: 我的 房间 很 小。
example.en: My room is small.

example.zh: 妈妈 在 厨房 煮饭。
example.en: Mum is cooking in the kitchen.

example.zh: 大家 在 客厅 看 电视。
example.en: Everyone's watching TV in the living room.

example.zh: 请问， 厕所 在 哪里？
example.en: Excuse me, where's the toilet?

items.note: Literally "cold air". Singaporeans also say 开冷气 for "switch on the air-con".

example.zh: 好 热， 开 冷气 吧。
example.en: So hot — turn on the air-con.

example.zh: 风扇 开 大 一点。
example.en: Turn the fan up a bit.

example.zh: 我 周末 洗衣服。
example.en: I do my laundry on weekends.

items.english: to hang clothes out to dry
items.note: Think of bamboo poles sticking out of HDB windows.

example.zh: 今天 太阳 大， 可以 晒衣服。
example.en: It's sunny today — good for drying clothes.

example.zh: 吃 完饭 我 来 扫地。
example.en: I'll sweep the floor after dinner.

example.zh: 今天 谁 煮饭？
example.en: Who's cooking today?

example.zh: 出门 的 时候 顺便 倒垃圾。
example.en: Take out the rubbish on your way out.

example.zh: 睡觉 前 记得 关灯。
example.en: Remember to switch off the lights before bed.

example.zh: 我 先 回家 了。
example.en: I'm heading home first.

example.zh: 我 八点 出门。
example.en: I leave the house at eight.

example.zh: 今天 我 在家 工作。
example.en: I'm working from home today.

example.zh: 我们 下个月 搬家。
example.en: We're moving house next month.

example.zh: 隔壁 在 装修， 很 吵。
example.en: Next door is renovating — so noisy.

example.zh: 我 忘 了 带 钥匙。
example.en: I forgot my keys.

example.zh: 今天 天气 怎么样？
example.en: How's the weather today?

example.zh: 新加坡 一年 四季 都 很 热。
example.en: Singapore is hot all year round.

example.zh: 下午 可能 会 下雨。
example.en: It might rain this afternoon.

example.zh: 带 雨伞 吧。
example.en: Bring an umbrella.

example.zh: 今天 好 闷热。
example.en: It's so muggy today.

items.note: Haze season usually comes around September–October.

example.zh: 烟雾 很 严重， 不 要 出门。
example.en: The haze is bad — don't go out.
